19-governance-and-flow-questions.html 7/10. A newcomer would be stuck on ITSM terms that show up in questions before they are explained, mainly DevOps and service level agreement.

24-mixed-scenario-drill.html 7/10. A newcomer would most struggle with the agile and cost words that are used before they are explained, such as sprint, backlog, product owner, earned value and CPI, because the lesson does not name the agile lessons as a prerequisite.

24-mixed-scenario-drill.html 7/10. A newcomer who knows the earlier PMP lessons would follow each question, but would struggle most with the dense Step 4 paragraph, which squeezes three topics and eight names into one block.

24-mixed-scenario-drill.html 7/10. A newcomer would struggle most with the agile words (sprint, velocity, retrospective) that appear without explanation, since the lesson does not list the Agile delivery lessons it relies on.

19-governance-and-flow-questions.html 7/10. A newcomer would mostly struggle with the ITSM vocabulary the questions use, such as principle names, event levels and lifecycle terms, which this practice lesson relies on from earlier lessons rather than explaining.
